summary: Frontend-only PREVIEW retest of 9 client bug-sheet items in the admin Option-E console, the public notice page and Section D of /register. Result: 5 PASS, 3 PARTIAL, 1 FAIL. Each item was checked end-to-end in Playwright with real data. PASS: #15 (approve moves the row to the Approved tab, shows the approved banner and creates vendor PMC-SUP-000059), #55 (a complete registration approves; an incomplete one shows a clear error toast listing the missing fields; clarify and reject both work), #18 (/admin/e/evaluation does not crash; Generate Award Report shows the ranking table for PMC-NOT-2026-0015 and 0016), #67 (Audit ledger and all 19 Masters tabs load without crashing), #23/#37 (a corrigendum published from admin on PMC-NOT-2026-0101 shows on the public /notices/{ref} page, and the admin diff PDF returns 200 application/pdf). PARTIAL: #43 rubric, #45 contracts, #60 auctions. FAIL: #6 Section D. Login note: the unified /login page re-renders about 3s after load, so fill the form only after waiting 5s or the input is wiped.

per_bug_status.#15 Registrations approve -> Approved ta: PASS. After Approve the filter switches to the Approved tab automatically. The row shows APPROVED and an 'Edit full vendor profile (PMC-SUP-000059)' link. The detail panel shows the REGISTRATION APPROVED banner with the vendor ref, and the action buttons are hidden. No stale detail is left on screen.
per_bug_status.#55 Approve/Reject/Clarify + incomplete-: PASS. The complete registration approves. The incomplete one shows the toast: 'Cannot approve — the supplier has not filled these required Section A fields: registered_address, registration_number, legal_entity_type'. Clarify without notes is blocked with 'Notes required'. Clarify with notes moves the row to the Needs-clarification tab, and Reject moves it to the Rejected tab. Minor: the toast shows raw snake_case keys and a generic 'Something went wrong · HTTP 400' prefix.
per_bug_status.#18 Evaluation screen + Award Report: PASS on /admin/e/evaluation, the route the sidebar uses. No crash for 0015, 0016, 0018 or 0106. The award-report table shows 2 ranked rows for 0015 and 0016. Side issue: the orphan route /admin/e/evaluations (AdminEvaluationListE.jsx) is a STATIC MOCK. It hard-codes PMC-NOT-2026-0055, 0038 and 0016 rows, and its 'Open room', 'View' and 'Report' links are href='#'. Anyone reaching it by URL sees fake data and dead buttons.
per_bug_status.#43 Rubric persistence after refresh: PARTIAL. Save works: POST returns 200 and the 'Rubric saved' toast appears. After re-picking the notice, GET /rubric/{ref} reloads the saved weights (0.35/0.25/0.45/55). But after a browser REFRESH the selected notice is lost: noticeRef is plain useState('') at EvaluationPanel.jsx:20 and is not stored in the URL or localStorage. The editor therefore shows DEFAULT_CRITERIA (0.3/0.3/0.4/60) until the admin picks the notice again, so to a user it looks like the weights were reset. Fix: keep noticeRef in ?notice= with useSearchParams and initialise from it.
per_bug_status.#45 BOQ & Contracts viewable: PARTIAL. On /admin/e/boq the Contracts tab lists 3 contracts, including PMC-CON-2026-0007 ('TEST_v56n contract · USD 1,000 · status active'). Gaps: (1) there is no View button or contract detail anywhere (boq/ContractsTab.jsx only shows ref, title, value, status and milestones; 0007 shows no milestones), so the 'View shows the contract' requirement is not met; (2) the page opens on the BOQ Templates tab, so admins must click Contracts first; (3) the URL in the bug sheet, /admin/e/boq-contracts, has no route and redirects to /admin/e/dashboard (App.js:253 only defines /admin/e/boq).
per_bug_status.#60 Reverse auction create/start + vendo: PARTIAL. Admin side PASS: creating an auction adds a DRAFT row. Start with 0 participants shows a clear toast: 'Cannot start auction — need at least 2 registered participants, currently 0'. Start with 2 participants shows 'Auction is now LIVE.' and the row status changes to LIVE. Vendor room /vendor/auction/{aid}: the bid input (ra-bid-price) and submit button exist, and a 49,000 bid was accepted. FAIL: the vendor list /vendor/auctions does NOT show the live auction the vendor registered for. GET /api/v1/reverse-auctions/mine (routers/auction_live.py:330-364) only matches auctions on notices the vendor bid on or holds an invitation for. It ignores reverse_auction_participants, so vendors who joined via the public link cannot find the auction to bid in. The same gap hides the closed TEST_v56n auctions that manualvendor WON.
per_bug_status.#67 Audit ledger + Masters: PASS. /admin/e/audit renders 500 events and /admin/e/masters renders Staff master. All 19 Masters tabs were clicked with no crash and no page errors.
per_bug_status.#23/#37 Corrigenda public display + diff: PASS for a notice with consistent dates. Publishing on PMC-NOT-2026-0101 showed 'Corrigendum No. 3 published', and the public page's notice-e-corrigenda section shows it. 'No corrigenda published' is not shown. The admin 'Download diff PDF' link (/api/v1/notices/{ref}/corrigenda/{id}/pdf) returns 200 application/pdf, and so does the public one. Problems that can still make the client think publishing is broken: (a) the corr-notice-picker lists UNPUBLISHED notices; publishing on PMC-NOT-2026-0106 gives 404 'Notice not found or not published', so the picker should filter to is_published; (b) client-side date-chain validation in CorrigendaPanel.jsx publish() (~line 190-200) does not match the backend. On PMC-NOT-2026-0102 the client checks passed, but the backend rejected with 400 'Bid Opening Date must be on or after Bid Submission End'. Notices whose existing dates are already out of order cannot receive any corrigendum, even a description-only change, unless the admin fixes the unrelated dates too; (c) NoticeDetailE.jsx still contains hard-coded mock blocks: the scope cards (Embryology lab / Cleanroom HVAC / Cryopreservation / Commissioning), 'Covers 3 sealed envelopes', 'Notice sealed on the ledger · notice.publish #1872', 'Corrigendum 1 · corrigendum.issue #1880', and the static Documents and Clarifications sections.
per_bug_status.#6 Section D required asterisk: FAIL. Field-level asterisks render correctly: data-testid=field-required-mark shows 5 bold red '*' in Section D (office name, country, address, state, city), 7 in A, 5 in B and 3 in C. But the red 'REQUIRED' PILL is still rendered for document slots by DocSlot.jsx:83-85 (docslot-required-*): 2 pills in Section D (IN GST, IN PAN country licences), 3 in A, 2 in B, 2 in C. SectionE.jsx:41 also prints an amber 'Required' word. When go-live is ON, Sector and Contract type in SectionD.jsx:76 and :87 put '*' into the label text (`label={goLive ? 'Sector *' : ...}`) instead of passing the `required` prop, so they get no red asterisk. The OPTIONAL pills are close to invisible in the E theme (low contrast). Stepper navigation (A to D, Next to Directors, Prev back to D) works.

minor.issue: Does not include auctions where the vendor is in reverse_auction_participants (joined via /register), so a live auction the vendor joined is missing from /vendor/auctions. Add a third match on reverse_auction_participants.vendor_id.

Re-validates the full date chain, including UNCHANGED legacy dates, so a description-only corrigendum on a notice with already out-of-order dates returns 400 (PMC-NOT-2026-0102: Bid Opening Date before Submission End).

ui_bugs.issue: #6: red 'REQUIRED' pill still rendered on mandatory document slots; client asked for a bold red asterisk only
Sector/Contract type use a literal 'Sector *' label instead of the required prop, so there is no red asterisk or field-required-mark when go-live is on
#43: selected notice is not persisted, so after a refresh the rubric shows defaults until the notice is re-picked
#45: no View action or contract detail view; only a summary line plus milestones
Static mock page with fake rows and dead '#' links
Lists unpublished notices; publishing on one gives 404 'not published'
With 0 bids it says 'No bid qualifies (all below the 60% technical cutoff)', which is misleading; it should say 'No bids received'

integration_issues.issue: /vendor/auctions list is empty for an auction the vendor registered on (backend /mine query gap)
Client-side chain validation passes but the backend rejects with 400 on legacy-inconsistent dates

issues: Hard-coded mock scope cards, ledger hashes (#1872/#1880), 'Covers 3 sealed envelopes', and static Documents/Clarifications shown on every real notice
Bid status pill (bg-slate-100) renders as a dark empty block in the E theme, so the text is unreadable
Duplicate Created by/From/To filter bars (MoneyPanelWithFilter + CreatorDateFilterBar)
Save Technical stays enabled after the technical envelope is sealed (readOnly only when both are locked)
OPTIONAL pill (bg-slate-200/text-slate-700) almost invisible in the E theme
Native browser date pickers (mm/dd/yyyy) used instead of the shadcn calendar
Inactive 'BOQ TEMPLATES' tab text is very low contrast

action_items: #6: In DocSlot.jsx:83-85, replace the red REQUIRED pill with the same bold red '*' (data-testid=field-required-mark style) and fix the OPTIONAL pill contrast. Pass `required={goLive}` to the Sector and Contract type Fields in SectionD.jsx:76,87 instead of putting '*' in the label. Consider dropping the amber 'Required' text at SectionE.jsx:41.
#43: Persist the evaluation noticeRef in the URL (?notice=PMC-NOT-...) at EvaluationPanel.jsx:20 so a refresh reloads the notice and its saved rubric.

#45: Add a View action and contract detail (drawer or route) in boq/ContractsTab.jsx; add a route alias /admin/e/boq-contracts -> /admin/e/boq; consider opening the Contracts tab by default or via ?tab=contracts.
#60: Extend GET /reverse-auctions/mine to include auctions where the vendor is in reverse_auction_participants, so live and won auctions appear on /vendor/auctions.

#23/#37: Filter the corrigenda notice picker to published notices. Make client-side date validation match the backend (bid_opening >= submission end), or have the backend validate only the dates that changed.
Remove or replace the static mock content in AdminEvaluationListE.jsx (/admin/e/evaluations) and the mock blocks in NoticeDetailE.jsx (scope cards, ledger hashes, Covers, Documents, Clarifications).

Minor: show human-readable labels instead of snake_case keys in the incomplete-registration approve toast; show 'No bids received' when the award report has 0 rows; fix the unreadable bid status pill in BidScoreList.jsx:23.
critical_code_review_comments: EvaluationPanel.jsx: rubric load swallows every error (catch {}), so a 500 is silently treated as 'no rubric'. Distinguish 404 from other errors.
EvaluationPanel.jsx: readOnly is only true when fullyLocked; with the technical envelope sealed, Save Technical stays clickable and depends on the backend refusing it.
AdminEvaluationListE.jsx and NoticeDetailE.jsx still carry large blocks of hard-coded design-mock HTML; useAdminEvaluationsLive only patches KPI figures, not the table rows.
CorrigendaPanel.jsx is 600+ lines and close to the 700-line split threshold.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Login: open /login, WAIT 5s (the page re-renders after /_version), click [data-testid=signin-role-admin], fill signin-e-email/password, click signin-e-submit; it lands on /admin/e/dashboard. rca of the issue: #43: the noticeRef React state is not persisted, so a refresh resets the UI to DEFAULT_CRITERIA (the backend does persist the rubric). #6: v52cy added REQUIRED/OPTIONAL pills to DocSlot independently of the Field asterisk revert, so the pill survives on document cards. #60 vendor list: the /mine query omits the participants collection. #45: ContractsTab has no detail view and the bug-sheet URL /admin/e/boq-contracts is not routed. #23/#37: the feature works, but the picker includes unpublished notices and the backend applies full-chain date validation to unchanged legacy dates, which leads to perceived failures.
